journey.name: Image select — cover from web (Unsplash) and gallery
journey.description: Choosing a card/cover image: open the image sheet from the Publish cover, search the web grid, and select a photo. The web grid needs an Unsplash access key — either the user's own (Settings, see journey 16) or the build-time UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY fallback in local.properties. With neither, the grid area shows the "add a key" panel and the web steps should be skipped. The gallery path opens the system photo picker, which cannot be reliably automated, so it is left as a manual check. Requires a signed-in session (journey 01).

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks" in the bottom tab bar
Type the following two lines into the field with resource-id "paste_input": "sol,sun", "luna,moon"
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_keep" twice to keep both cards and advance to Publish
Tap the element with resource-id "publish_cover_change" to open the cover image sheet
Verify the image sheet shows a search field (resource-id: image_search_input) and a "From gallery" button (resource-id: image_pick_gallery)

If a key is configured: type "sun" into the field with resource-id "image_search_input", verify the web image grid (resource-id: image_grid) populates, tap the first cell (resource-id: image_grid_cell), then tap "Done" (resource-id: image_sheet_done) and verify the cover thumbnail updates on the Publish screen

Attribution (Unsplash API guidelines): with the grid populated, verify every visible cell shows the photographer's name over a gradient at its bottom edge, and that the credit line (resource-id: image_credit) below the grid reads "Photos from Unsplash" before a selection and "Photo by NAME on Unsplash" after one

Tap the photographer's name in the credit line and verify a browser opens their Unsplash profile with utm_source=loopky and utm_medium=referral in the URL; go back and tap "Unsplash" in the same line to verify it opens unsplash.com with the same params

If no key is configured: verify the grid area shows the panel with resource-id "image_sheet_key_panel" rather than the grid, that no credit line is shown, and skip the web selection steps — the key path itself is covered by journey 16
Manual check (system picker not automatable): tap "From gallery" (resource-id: image_pick_gallery), choose an image, and verify it is compressed and shown as the cover
